title: Black Silk
overview: 1931, Shanghai. In a maze of luxurious nightclubs and neon streets, foreign intelligence collides. A secret cargo, codenamed Black Silk, is being transported to the city. In search of a mysterious object, the heroes get on a passenger liner and an airship, which turn out to be huge traps. There are Japanese agents all around, the endless ocean and sky are overboard, and time is running out by the minute.

title: The Last Dinosaur
overview: Rex the dinosaur, whose father is the king of dinosaurs is snatched and transported to the 21st century in a time machine, and must team up with a motely crew in an attempt to find his way home, 65 million years back in time.

title: Вся эта любовь
overview: Successful St. Petersburg restaurateur Mark lives in a whirlwind of vibrant events and social adventures: parties, tastings, boisterous gatherings, beautiful girlfriends and cheerful friends with their own crushes, romances, and betrayals. But one day, Mark will have to make a choice: a world of fleeting desires and thrills or a feeling that happens only once and lasts forever.

title: Veselchak U
overview: Space pirate Veselchak U is stranded on Earth in the present day after a run-in with Alisa Selezneva, her mother, and high school students from a Moscow school. More than anything, he wants to seize the cosmion, return to his own time, and finally lead the Pirate Alliance. His search for the artifact leads him to a boy, Yura, and his mother, Katya, who are mysteriously connected to the cosmion. When the powerful space warrior Theo begins hunting them, Veselchak is forced to defend Yura and Katya-for he is a noble pirate. Together, they embark on a dangerous journey filled with adventures to uncover all the secrets of their past and future.

title: Monitor
overview: A social media moderator unleashes a deadly terror when she refuses to publish a cryptic video.

title: Лукоморье
overview: Masha Aksyonova is a quiet, straight-A student passionate about literature. Ivan Krasilov is her polar opposite: a charismatic jokester and a master of getting into trouble. But everything changes when, during a school field trip, the two of them fall through a portal and find themselves... in the very real Lukomore. The schoolchildren are greeted by a world of fairy tales, but it is no longer as Pushkin described it. The golden chain has been removed. The Cat no longer tells stories-he's suffering from a creative crisis, and Koschey is ready to turn anyone who stands in his way to stone. To return home, Masha and Ivan must overcome magical trials and unravel the mystery of the missing lines of "Lukomore." Walking "along unknown paths," they meet the witty, learned Cat, the feisty Baba Yaga, the formidable Leshiy, and the flirtatious Rusalka.

title: Fencing Teacher
overview: Eight years after her defeat in an Olympic final, sabre fencer Marina Yakovleva decides to return to elite-level sport, aiming to win the World Championship and prove that her story is not yet over. She begins training under Adarov—a legendary coach who has since been all but forgotten—who unexpectedly brings her long-time rival, Olympic champion Karina Grigoryan, back onto the national team. Under the guidance of this stern and unpredictable mentor, the two former adversaries find themselves face-to-face on the fencing strip once again, where they must contend not only with each other, but also with their own fears, ambitions, and the ghosts of their past.

title: The Myth of Maracuda: Sugar Age
Magic Lamp
overview: Shy and sometimes naive schoolboy Sashka lives with his grandmother and confides his secrets to a smart speaker because he has no friends. But Sashka has a special power - faith in miracles, thanks to which he gets into a whirlpool of extraordinary events. In the company of a witty genie from a jug and a smart speaker that has come to life, Alisa, Sashka sets off on a dangerous journey across half the world to find his parents, who after a sandstorm in Uzbekistan ended up in a magical city, captive to Shah Zaman. Sashka and company will face the machinations of the evil sorcerer Yusuf, battles on flying carpets, hot air balloon trips, chases across endless steppes, crossing the desert and meeting people who are ready to help the boy find his family again.

title: Hanna
overview: Following her father’s arrest in Nazi Germany, Hannah’s family flees to Leningrad, where they are caught up in the Great Patriotic War. Left without a mother, Hannah finds a close companion in Maria, a neighbor who shares their communal apartment.

title: Angel Street
overview: Angel Street is a heartwarming story about the miracles we often overlook in everyday life. For five centuries, an Angel has faithfully watched over a single street. But when he comes to believe that people no longer need him—too absorbed in their daily worries to hear his voice—he makes an extraordinary decision. Entrusting his powers to a young boy, the Angel sets out to experience life as a human for three days.
